trips.name: Annapurna Ski Expedition
trips.blurb: Luxury ski expedition in the Annapurna region, skiing up to Thorong La (5,416m) from a heated private base camp. No touring experience needed.

trips.name: Annapurna Sanctuary Ski Tour
trips.meta: 14 days · your first ski tour · waitlist open
trips.blurb: Ski the bowls around Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m), beneath Annapurna I. Built for confident piste skiers who have never toured.

trips.name: Mera Peak Ski Expedition
trips.blurb: Climb Mera Peak and ski it: six planned ski days, heated camps and a helicopter out of the Hinku valley.

trips.name: Himlung Himal Ski Expedition
trips.blurb: Ski a 7,000m peak from the hidden Nar Phu valley, with five to seven planned ski days and a helicopter in and out.

trips.name: Putha Hiunchuli Ski Expedition
trips.blurb: Remote Dolpo and one of the most skiable 7,000m peaks in Nepal, with five to seven planned ski days.
